sections.advice: Use Hannover south gate → Coppenbrügge Ith road as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

sections.advice: Coppenbrügge Ith road → Eschershausen Hils road is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.
sections.photoQuery: Coppenbrügge Ith road Eschershausen Hils road Hannover / Lower Saxony escapes

sections.advice: This Eschershausen Hils road → Alfeld food stop stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.
